'''Ter22''' was a very efficient [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] manufactured by [[Girodyne/Legends|Girodyne]] and installed in standard models of the [[CL-1c Lancet interceptor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
